source_caption_text:
2 years ago today, Future dropped MIXTAPE PLUTO 🦅. What are your favorite tracks from the project 🤔⁉️

Future’s “Teflon Don” is a perfect example of him getting completely locked into a flow. Running for just over two minutes, the track has him riding the beat almost nonstop, with barely any space between his lines. From the opening seconds, he finds a pocket and stays there.

What makes it hit so hard is how effortless Future sounds while doing it. There’s no big hook breaking things up or a long pause to reset the track. He just keeps sliding over the dark production, switching his cadence and vocal inflections while making the whole performance feel almost hypnotic.

Future really sounds like he entered a different flow state on this one. For two straight minutes, he’s locked into the beat and just floating over it, making “Teflon Don” feel less like a traditional song and more like one long run of pure Future.

#future #rap #hiphop
